$comment: Shared contract for composing a post's single blob of text.
Two implementations exist and must agree: backend `compose_post_text` in
app/publishing/rules.py, which produces the text that is actually posted,
and frontend `composePostText` in lib/postText.ts, which backs the Copy
button. They are hand-mirrored across languages, so nothing but a shared
fixture stops them drifting — each suite asserting its own hardcoded
strings would let one side change and both stay green, and the first
symptom would be a copied post that differs from the published one.
Both suites iterate every case below. Add cases here, not in one suite.

cases.name: body, call to action and hashtags, in that order
cases.expected:
Enrol now: our courses.

Book your spot.

#WRCC #LearnLocal

cases.name: no hashtags
cases.expected:
Enrol now: our courses.

Book your spot.

cases.name: blank hashtag entries are dropped, not emitted as spaces
surrounding whitespace is trimmed from every section
an empty call to action is treated as absent
blank lines inside the body survive untouched
